two_stage.why: REQUIRED_EXACT_COUNT means the budget must be exact BEFORE launch. It does NOT mean the observed number must already have been observed before launch.

settled_law.non_substitutability: Literal path opens, reader invocations and decoder invocations are separately named, non-substitutable quantities. A higher-level proxy may not be renamed path_opens.

account_object_shape.layer: string — the layer at which the quantity is counted

expected_pre_launch_budget.budget_value: integer, or null ONLY when budget_type is UNBOUND_PENDING_TECHNICAL_ACCEPTANCE
expected_pre_launch_budget.budget_expression: string, used when the authority states the budget in words
expected_pre_launch_budget.may_be_null: always false — the budget object itself is never null or absent

measurement_basis.what_measured: required — what quantity is being counted
measurement_basis.mechanism: required — by what mechanism, or PENDING: <owner to be established>
measurement_basis.point_in_run: required — at what point in the run

runtime_observed_exact_count.must_not_be_read_as: a zero, an empty result, or a PASS

account_object_shape.provenance: required — list of exact artifact@commit:json.path citations
account_object_shape.pending_dependency: optional — typed token when the value awaits technical acceptance

EXACT.meaning: Authority froze a specific count. The observed count must equal it.

MAX.meaning: Authority froze a ceiling. The observed count may be lower but never higher.

ZERO.meaning: Hard zero. A single non-zero observation is a STOP condition, not a reportable variance.

FLOOR.meaning: Authority froze a minimum that must be reached. It is NOT a ceiling and MUST NOT be promoted to one.
FLOOR.example: SRC27 metadata_reads floor = 1, from the 'at minimum' wording of the hardened note

UNBOUND_PENDING_TECHNICAL_ACCEPTANCE.meaning: Authority named the account as mandatory but supplied no number. The value awaits technical acceptance. This is a TYPED BUDGET STATE, not a null, and it waives nothing.
UNBOUND_PENDING_TECHNICAL_ACCEPTANCE.example: path_level_opens on the six non-SRC27 sources

pre_launch_budget.rationale: A null or absent pre-launch budget would silently waive a mandatory launch prerequisite.

machine_readable_rule.rationale: An absent or null pre-launch budget would silently waive a launch prerequisite. An UNBOUND_PENDING_TECHNICAL_ACCEPTANCE budget is an explicit, non-waiving blocker.

mandatory_separate_accounts: file hash passes (full SHA-256 over the file)
